summary: Ghost is an open-source platform designed for publishing blogs and managing content. Written in Node.js and distributed under the MIT licence, it provides a dedicated environment for creating and organising text-based articles.
goodFor: It suits individuals or teams who want a focused, self-hosted space dedicated specifically to publishing a blog without the wider scope of a general content management system.
watchOut: You will need to manage your own server updates, backups, and security hardening, as with any self-hosted publishing tool.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, it typically requires a process manager like PM2, a reverse proxy such as Nginx to handle TLS termination, and a persistent database backend.
